external_dependencies: External Sources (Public Data Sets, Research Partners)
project_info.network_architecture: Multi-tier cloud architecture with secure connectivity from external sources via VPN/Direct Connect, centralized data ingestion layer, data lake storage with processing capabilities, and multiple consumption layers for different user types. Management and security services span across all tiers.
key_components: Ingest Layer (Amazon AppFlow, AWS Transfer for SFTP, AWS Snow Family)
Data Lake (AWS Lake Formation, Amazon S3, AWS Glue)
Machine Learning Platform (Amazon SageMaker, Amazon EC2)
Management & Security Layer (IAM, KMS, GuardDuty, Macie, Config, CloudTrail, CloudWatch)
Amazon HealthLake for FHIR data processing

all_threats.statement: A malicious insider with legitimate access credentials, can exfiltrate sensitive patient data through AWS Transfer for SFTP endpoints, which leads to unauthorized disclosure of PHI, resulting in reduced confidentiality of patient health records.
all_threats.threatAction: exfiltrate sensitive patient data through AWS Transfer for SFTP endpoints

all_threats.statement: A cybercriminal with compromised IAM credentials, can manipulate data processing workflows in AWS Glue, which leads to corruption of healthcare analytics datasets, resulting in reduced integrity of data warehouse information.
all_threats.threatAction: manipulate data processing workflows in AWS Glue

all_threats.statement: An advanced persistent threat actor with network access, can exploit vulnerabilities in custom applications running on Amazon ECS, which leads to lateral movement within the analytics platform, resulting in reduced confidentiality of FHIR data in Amazon HealthLake.
all_threats.threatAction: exploit vulnerabilities in custom applications running on Amazon ECS
all_threats.threatImpact: lateral movement within the analytics platform

all_threats.statement: A malicious attacker with compromised service account, can perform privilege escalation attacks against AWS Lake Formation permissions, which leads to unauthorized access to regulated healthcare datasets, resulting in reduced confidentiality of patient analytics data.
all_threats.threatAction: perform privilege escalation attacks against AWS Lake Formation permissions
all_threats.threatImpact: unauthorized access to regulated healthcare datasets

all_threats.statement: A threat actor with access to QuickSight dashboards, can perform injection attacks through dashboard parameters, which leads to unauthorized query execution against Redshift data warehouses, resulting in reduced confidentiality of aggregated patient data.
all_threats.threatAction: perform injection attacks through dashboard parameters
all_threats.threatImpact: unauthorized query execution against Redshift data warehouses

all_threats.statement: A malicious actor with API access, can perform denial of service attacks against AWS AppSync endpoints, which leads to disruption of real-time healthcare data access, resulting in reduced availability of clinical decision support systems.
all_threats.threatAction: perform denial of service attacks against AWS AppSync endpoints
all_threats.threatImpact: disruption of real-time healthcare data access

all_threats.statement: A malicious user with Lambda execution permissions, can deploy malicious code in serverless functions, which leads to unauthorized data processing and exfiltration, resulting in reduced integrity of machine learning training datasets in SageMaker.
all_threats.threatAction: deploy malicious code in serverless functions
all_threats.impactedAssets: machine learning training datasets in SageMaker

all_threats.statement: A threat actor with misconfigured S3 bucket access, can perform unauthorized data enumeration on raw healthcare data, which leads to exposure of unencrypted patient information, resulting in reduced confidentiality of ingested healthcare records.
all_threats.threatAction: perform unauthorized data enumeration on raw healthcare data

all_threats.statement: An attacker with VPN or Direct Connect access, can intercept data in transit between customer-hosted EHR systems and AWS services, which leads to unauthorized access to patient data during migration, resulting in reduced confidentiality of electronic health records.
all_threats.threatAction: intercept data in transit between customer-hosted EHR systems and AWS services
all_threats.threatImpact: unauthorized access to patient data during migration

all_threats.statement: A malicious data scientist with SageMaker notebook access, can extract sensitive features from ML models, which leads to inference of patient identities from anonymized datasets, resulting in reduced confidentiality of de-identified health information.
all_threats.threatAction: extract sensitive features from ML models
all_threats.threatImpact: inference of patient identities from anonymized datasets

all_threats.statement: An unauthorized user with weak authentication credentials, can gain access to Athena query interfaces, which leads to execution of resource-intensive queries, resulting in reduced availability of analytical services for legitimate users.
all_threats.threatAction: gain access to Athena query interfaces

all_threats.statement: A malicious actor with access to CloudWatch logs, can perform log analysis to extract sensitive information patterns, which leads to reconnaissance of system architecture and data flows, resulting in reduced confidentiality of operational metadata.
all_threats.threatAction: perform log analysis to extract sensitive information patterns
all_threats.threatImpact: reconnaissance of system architecture and data flows
